project: OS3 - Open Source Security Score Platform
problem: Developers unknowingly use insecure or vulnerable open-source packages
solution: OS3 analyzes dependencies, assigns security scores, detects CVEs, and provides AI-driven fix recommendations
how_to_use: Upload your package.json or requirements.txt and OS3 will scan all dependencies for known vulnerabilities
tech_stack: React, Vite, FastAPI, FAISS, Sentence Transformers, Ollama
